brands.name: McCallum Surfboards
brands.short_description: Hand-shaped alternative surfboards by Jeff McCallum in San Diego — PDX quads, twin eggs, fish, and step-up midlengths blending retro lines with modern performance.

models.name: PDX
models.description: The PDX is the meat and potatoes of what I do. The original design was called a Quagg, for Quad+Egg, which went through a few alterations eventually ending in the PDX. The design came from the fish craze in the early 2000s when I was riding classic fish in the 5'4"–5'6" range but wanted something longer. As the fish grew in length they started to track, so I combined a fish with a round pin to put some curve in the rail and loosen them up. Of the nearly 8000 boards I've hand shaped, the PDX has been by far the most popular — they paddle great, are fast and super loose, sort of a best of both worlds.

models.name: Kimbo
models.description: The Kimbo was named after my English mastiff who passed away in 2018. I had an idea of a modified T-Egg designed for winter swell, with a more streamlined, pulled-in outline but the same general design cues. It was originally designed around a step-up gun but after riding it for a year straight in all conditions it became a favorite — still my go-to when the waves get punchy, big or small. I've since shrunk the original 8'0" to 7'0" and everything in between; the 7'0" comes out less pulled in in the tail and turns into a great all-arounder and one-board quiver in punchy waves.

models.name: T-Egg
models.description: The T-Egg started as a last-minute fin change on an already glassed board, which turned into probably my favorite board in the last 15 years. The long straight, parallel rails add down-the-line speed and drive, then the parallel pivot point of the twin keeps it loose and flowing. The added volume of the midlength creates a ton of paddle power helping it excel in small to well overhead surf. This is now my current go-to all-a-rounder and a must on any surf trip especially if I can only take one board.

models.name: JMF
models.description: The JMF — Jeff McCallum Fish — is a classic quad fish with a Future quad fin setup. A staple fish template in the McCallum lineup for riders who want the speed and looseness of a traditional fish with modern quad drive.

models.name: Q-Egg
models.description: Q stands for quad. The Q-Egg is a playful quad-fin egg that is super fun in a variety of waves, with just the right amount of rocker to help maneuver a wider template through those sneaky little sections. Ready for surfers who want to catch more waves without giving up performance.

models.name: Caster
models.description: The Caster is a versatile quad-fin template in the McCallum lineup — a well-rounded design built for speed and flow across a wide range of conditions. Remember, it's always faster on a Caster.

models.name: GYP
models.description: The GYP is a fish model designed off a Skip Frye template. Lots of volume where you need it with Skip rails to help transition from rail to rail. Inspired from Skip's fish with turned-up rails to counter the width — a classic wide fish for spring and summer sessions.
